svg.title: Staff dashboard and Skills ecosystem
svg.desc: Staff dashboard: A modular admin NUI with 23 modules: bans, permissions, players, vehicles, finance and gangs, with every action sent to a rate-limited audit log. Resources: staff v2.0.0, reborn_logs v2.0.0. Skills ecosystem: One core API drives eight skills (mining, woodcutting, fishing, hunting, diving, combat, smithing, carpentry) with XP bombs and leaderboards. Resources: skills_core v1.2.0, 8 skills, server-validated.
